items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: he was recording with Jimmy Dorsey, he was recording with Andy Ione and everybody else... I know you were on at least three different sessions

ctx.x: Then the thing was when Louie went to make the picture in California, he wasn't recording with his own band, he was recording with Jimmy Dorsey, he was recording with Andy Ione and everybody else, but he wasn't using his own band.
I know you were on at least three different sessions but I think they were all done in the spring of '36.
